title: RouteWarden Configuration
description: JSON schema for RouteWarden HTTP security middleware (Traefik, Caddy, NGINX / OpenResty).

enabled.description: Master switch to enable or bypass RouteWarden inspection.

enableDefaultPatterns.description: Enable built-in sensitive path patterns (.env, .git, .aws, keys, credentials, db dumps, actuator, container configs, wp-config, etc.).

pathPatterns.description: Custom regular expressions for paths to block (synonym for blockPatterns).

blockPatterns.description: Custom regular expressions for paths to block.

allowPatterns.description: Whitelisted regular expressions that take precedence over block patterns.

allowedIps.description: List of client IP addresses or CIDR blocks exempted from all security rules.

methods.description: HTTP request methods to inspect (e.g. GET, POST, HEAD, PUT, DELETE).

checkQuery.description: Inspect URL query strings and individual query parameters against block patterns.

checkHeaders.description: Optional list of HTTP request headers to inspect for path smuggling (e.g. X-Forwarded-Uri, X-Rewrite-URL, X-Original-URL).

statusCode.description: Default HTTP status code when blocking a request.

customResponseText.description: Custom response body text when blocking requests.

silentDrop.description: Immediately terminate TCP connection without sending an HTTP response.

debug.description: Enable verbose inspection and candidate-path evaluation logs.

securityLog.description: Emit structured CrowdSec/SIEM-compatible JSON log events on every block event.

mode.description: Response action when a request is blocked.

headers.description: Custom key-value HTTP headers sent with the blocked response.

proxyUrl.description: Honeypot upstream backend URL when mode is 'proxy'.

gzipBombMB.description: Decompressed size in megabytes for gzipBomb mode.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Retry-After header duration in seconds for rateLimitChallenge mode.

tarpitDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between bytes for tarpit mode.

tarpitMaxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum connection duration in seconds for tarpit mode.

streamSizeMB.description: Maximum payload size in megabytes for infiniteStream mode.

siteKey.description: Public site key for the captcha widget.

title.description: HTML page title for the challenge page.

template.description: Custom Go HTML template string for the captcha page.
